title: Advancements in Single-Nanoparticle Photocatalysis: Dispersing and Probing Doped SrTiO3 via Liquid-Phase TEM
content: The hydrogen evolution activity of nanoparticulate photocatalysts is commonly understood by measuring renewable hydrogen gas (H2) produced at the macroscopic scale. Materials characterization is typically conducted ex-situ to explain performance afterward, while structure and activity are rarely characterized simultaneously in operando. [1] Doing so at the level of individual nanoparticles or agglomerates holds immense potential for uncovering fundamental mechanisms of hydrogen production.
